target.scope_note: Synthetic local account fixtures executing retained original Pump and original dependency binaries. No production signer, live victim, current Devnet deployment, profitable extraction, or aggregate loss is asserted. Every artifact contains loaded binary hashes, signatures, errors, logs, and state deltas.

findings.scope: Pump Main creator migration with synthetic paused sharing state; exceptional state admission only.
findings.evidence: Signed migrate_bonding_curve_creator succeeded with SharingConfig status=0 and matching creator/admin, changing the curve creator without an Active-status check. Signature 64zbpAXH4KvKsiTmkVa1M5jGFEyRJWrB5M4E3gLAQBDL7Xnw1LDHGA8DigZ2oQLWHaRYrPqjAiH8aRVQBHZhfcCs.

findings.scope: Pump Main user-signed accumulator closure with pending incentive rights and native/token cashback.
findings.evidence: Close succeeded despite pending_unclaimed=123, deleted the accumulator, refunded all 2,844,400 lamports (rent plus 1,000,000 excess) to the user, and left the token-cashback ATA unchanged. This confirms rights erasure and native/token recoverability, not external close authority. Signature 3S2BSJA9ALZsaWGK2TmRs1UcHMMcFLmk2YwMVvoT3Pj2iV5HxGt1e37GUby6jxWr1TXtH9R1x6ERg2apP8uPRbyp.

No profitable donor extraction was tested or claimed. Signature 3SVgfK72SWTwXMk61HhMbvyP7oDyvzaf1oLCRKepMWRjuq9znFpm6RbbC17zdsjUGKUoNHZETBNsJh3rs7M7AXJu.

findings.scope: Pump Main only, as assigned; nonsigning user and foreign-mint cashback counter boundary. No AMM evidence or coordination.
findings.evidence: A payer-signed foreign-token claim starting at stable_claimed=42 succeeded and saturated the counter to u64::MAX. A separate positive claim at saturation panicked with 'Overflowing total stable cashback claimed'. A separate native claim at stable saturation succeeded, leaving that counter unchanged. Tokens still moved to the user in the successful saturation case.
